And  while  we  trust  that  through  the  intercession  of  the  holy 
Pontiff  Gregory  God  may  graciously  hear  our  prayer,  we  impart 
to  all  of  you.  Venerable  Brothers,  and  to  your  clergy  and  people, 
the  apostolic  benediction  with  all  the  affection  of  our  heart,  as  a 
pledge  of  heavenly  favors  and  in  token  of  our  paternal  good  will.

feast  of  St.  Gregory  I.,  Pope  and  Doctor  of  the  Church,  in  the  first 
year  of  our  Pontificate.
